title: Sprint planning puts kb/_self/code.md in the touches of an item that adds a _tools module
goal: An item whose goal adds a new _tools/*.py module carries kb/_self/code.md in its touches (its subsystem bullet lists every module of a prefix), and the kb-sprint plan step says so beside the docs map rule (SP-5y4ut64g close: ST-b2k5y46l and ST-ykdwo7a3 stopped at land's stale step on code.md and needed a touch widening and a worker resume each).

run:
import re, sys
t = open(".claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
step = t[t.index("## plan"):t.index("## start")]
sys.exit(0 if re.search(r"new tool module[^.]*code\.md", step) else 1)
